discovered_obligations.summary: Any semantic or governance policy that is not derivable from provider facts remains an explicit typed transformation input inside the candidate DataFusion session. Production composition must supply and prove those inputs directly; neither a bootstrap metamodel nor a ModelEpoch-to-schema projection is a target prerequisite.

The current tree implements a programmatically provisioned append-only Delta activation-control table, typed exact version vectors, canonical transaction-marker mapping, decodable durable rows, exact commit evidence, workspace-scoped DataFusion readback, cold epoch reconstruction, and a composite semantic-chain/independent-writer-fence authority port. WP17-WP18 still require concrete cache/acknowledgement/factory composition and complete named acceptance evidence.

The daemon still needs concrete workspace command-runtime factories which install the existing Delta activation event/marker/authority adapters with cache and acknowledgement ports, semantic-context and remaining durable effect backends, relational query-runtime wiring, and lifecycle/source-wave composition; tested isolated adapters are not production cutover evidence.

The current tree constructs and proves programmatic catalog/schema/dependency/provenance observations in a candidate DataFusion session, historicizes them as exact Delta versions, and reconstructs a fresh sealed session from an activation-selected vector. Remaining work is to migrate production epoch/program/query/lifecycle consumers to this authority and delete BootstrapMetamodel, replayed schema registries, model-to-schema DTO projections, and model-digest schema authority.

The current bounded proportional cache profile is a safe explicit release input, not a performance claim. Later workload evidence must feed cache-hit, planning-latency, memory-pressure, and update-amplification relations before changing metadata, statistics, listing, logical-plan, materialization, or clustering policy.

Design v2, the selected v2.0 authoritative suite, and plan v2 still declare replayed model/bootstrap authority. A versioned successor design and suite must make provider facts, explicit typed governance inputs, programmatic transformations, candidate-session catalog construction, and exact Delta history the sole target before another implementation packet is accepted.

The five catalog-observation families and activation control are historicized today. The successor design must classify every proof-bearing intermediate relation that activation, restart, audit, incremental recomputation, or provenance closure needs as a stable append-only Delta history with exact version pins, while leaving purely reconstructible execution buffers transient Arrow state.

The existing independent evidence corpus contains a bootstrap-model expectation and a mandatory WP01/comparator dependency. Preserve independently authored non-bootstrap semantic expectations only after review; replace bootstrap/comparator authority with first-principles invariants, exact pinned API facts, released public contracts, causal faults, and direct end-to-end proof of the final implementation.

BootstrapMetamodel, ModelMigration replay, FabricCompilerRelease schema authority, the legacy importer, ModelEpoch-to-schema projection, the old FabricEpoch builder, and exported relational_model surfaces remain compiled beside ProgrammaticFabricEpoch. The successor plan must route production consumers first and then prove their complete structural, textual, package, feature, test, and compiler-level absence.

plan_deviations.summary: The owner explicitly approved plan v2, waived its separately governed candidate-readiness prerequisite as impractical for this redesign, and then directed the repository active-plan pointer to select v2. The repository activation transaction created this state and changed the pointer; the waived prerequisite is not treated as packet-completion evidence.

Owner-directed rapid redesign work began across later packets before WP22 independently accepted its expectations and before predecessor packets obtained proving commits. Acceptance will therefore use a successor first-principles evidence transaction authored from the v2 design, exact pinned provider APIs, released public contracts, and independently specified executable invariants without target-output authority. A predecessor comparator is optional comparison/migration evidence only; its absence cannot block target acceptance. Every dependent packet remains subject to current-tree revalidation before completion.

The owner rejected the replayed bootstrap as unnecessary duplication of Arrow/DataFusion capabilities and clarified that schemas and downstream CPG data are constructed programmatically from exact provider facts and transformations within the candidate session context. The newly added bootstrap/replay assurance recipes were removed; affected replay/model projection work is now a decommission target, while explicit semantic/governance inputs remain ordinary typed transformation inputs rather than bootstrap declarations.

The owner directed exact-version Delta historicization plus caching of repeated DataFusion planning and runtime file work. The implementation keeps Delta table versions authoritative, caches compiled and optimized logical plans only under complete epoch/version/program/runtime/policy keys, retains DataFusion metadata/statistics/listing caches under explicit finite bounds, and intentionally rebuilds physical plans and query results.

Current-tree evidence confirms that owner-approved design changes invalidate the bootstrap/model foundation, model-derived schema authority, mandatory predecessor evidence ordering, and related cutover/decommission packets. Plan v2 is preserved as immutable history and marked invalidated; reusable Arrow IPC, provider, relational-program, authorization, Delta, activation, cache, query, and analysis work must be remapped into a successor design and plan.

Earlier per-packet blocker text requiring predecessor/evidence acceptance is historical. Successor completion requires independently authored first-principles evidence and causal proof; a predecessor comparator is optional migration/rationalization evidence and cannot block target acceptance.

The v2 authority-cutover machinery is executable and currently selects exactly one v2.0 suite, but that suite still declares replayed model/bootstrap authority. Structural authority-selection success therefore proves routing only and cannot validate the now-approved semantic target.

next_action: Create a versioned successor target design and authoritative suite that make programmatic candidate-session schemas, exact provider facts plus typed transformations, stable Delta histories for proof-bearing intermediate relations, exact-version activation/recovery, bounded DataFusion caches, and first-principles evidence normative; then derive a successor implementation plan that remaps reusable packets and makes bootstrap/model/dual-epoch purge an early dependency-closed cutover.
